# /instinct-export

Invoke the `neva-core:continuous-learning-v2` skill in export mode. Run:

```bash
python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/continuous-learning-v2/scripts/instinct-cli.py" export $ARGUMENTS
```

Flags: `--domain`, `--min-confidence`, `--output`, `--scope project|global|all`, `--format instincts|claude-md`. Report the file written and the instinct count. Only instincts are exported, never raw observations.
